name: openshuki
description: Personal-assistant scaffold with Express backend, React frontend, and subprocess agents

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "cd backend && pnpm dev" "cd frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -n backend -c cyan "cd backend && pnpm dev"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently -n frontend -c magenta "cd frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.build:backend: concurrently -n backend -c cyan "cd backend && pnpm build"
scripts.build:frontend: concurrently -n frontend -c magenta "cd frontend && pnpm build"
scripts.agents:install: concurrently -n agents -c yellow "cd agents && pnpm install && pip install -r requirements.txt"
